note: Catalogue properties with a flink consumer that THIS build does not read, each with its reason. The coverage test fails when a flink property is neither applied by BundleProfileMapper nor listed here. A property listed here is still validated and stored by the control plane; the bundle validator reports it as NOT_READ_BY_BUILD so a change to it is never mistaken for a runtime change.

unsupported.G0.required_signal_max_age_s: STALE_AGE_DECIDED_AT_INGESTION: the ingestion joiner's grid and hold rules decide freshness; the profile governs VP age (G11.instrument_verified_max_age_s)
unsupported.G0.max_gap_s: GAP_POLICY_COMPILED: a gap restarts the G12 capture ring (g12-max-gap-s job argument) and the window tiers count coverage; no separate gap threshold is read
unsupported.G0.alignment_tolerance_s: ALIGNMENT_COMPILED: the ingestion joiner aligns roles on its grid; G13 aligns peers within 0.75 grid (fixed)
unsupported.G0.min_samples: WINDOW_CONTRACT_COMPILED: the per-window sample floors are the compiled execution plan (min_samples per horizon)
unsupported.G0.jitter_warn_fraction: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: sample-interval jitter is retained in the G0 delta_t_s artifact but no warning threshold is applied
unsupported.G1.transition_guard_s: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: mode transfers segment the G12 capture immediately; no guard interval around a transfer is applied to the window tiers
unsupported.G1.authority_max_age_s: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: controlling-authority age is not evaluated (mode is taken as reported)
unsupported.G2.step_min_pv_eu: G12_TRIGGER_GOVERNS_EVENTS: set-point events are detected by the response job (G12.step_min_input_eu / step_min_span_fraction); G2 reports the events it is given
unsupported.G2.ramp_min_pv_eu_per_s: RAMP_THRESHOLD_COMPILED: the response job's ramp classification uses its compiled slope / duration (g12 job arguments)
unsupported.G2.event_dwell_s: G12_TRIGGER_GOVERNS_EVENTS: the response job's event dwell is a job argument (g12-event-dwell-s), not a per-loop property in this build
unsupported.G2r.out_of_domain_warn_fraction: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: G2r reports the out-of-domain fraction; the WARN threshold is compiled
unsupported.G3.error_band_abs_pv_eu: SPAN_FRACTION_ONLY: the good-error band is a fraction of the declared PV span (G3.error_band_span_fraction); an absolute EU band is not read
unsupported.G3.ewma_alpha: FILTER_COMPILED: the PV filter is the profile pack's pvFilter (type / window), not an EWMA alpha property
unsupported.G3.baseline_min_valid_s: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: no baseline benchmark interval is evaluated for G3
unsupported.G4.min_pv_excitation_pv_eu: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: G4 normalises by span, no PV excitation floor is applied
unsupported.G4.travel_rate_min_support_s: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: travel per day is reported from the window support; no minimum support gate
unsupported.G5.acf_lag_max_s: ACF_LAG_COMPILED: the ACF is evaluated to min(n/2, 2000) samples; the band comes from G5.period_min_s / period_max_s
unsupported.G6.spectral_concentration_warn: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: spectral entropy is reported; no concentration WARN threshold is applied
unsupported.G6.harmonic_max_order: HARMONIC_ORDER_COMPILED: harmonic energy is read at fixed orders in the PSD
unsupported.G7.shape_score_warn: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: G7 reports PASS / STRONG (G7.shape_score_high); no WARN level
unsupported.G7.min_cycle_amplitude: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: cycle acceptance is by regularity and completeness; no amplitude floor
unsupported.G8.max_lag_s: LAG_RANGE_COMPILED: the lag structure is evaluated to min(200, n/4) samples
unsupported.G8.surrogate_repetitions: SURROGATES_NOT_INSTALLED: SURROGATE_NONLINEARITY_V1 is not installed (G8 is XCORR_ASYMMETRY_V1)
unsupported.G8.significance_alpha: SURROGATES_NOT_INSTALLED: no significance test in this build
unsupported.G9.area_display_threshold: DISPLAY_THRESHOLD_COMPILED: the STRONG geometry threshold is compiled (0.30 phase area per cycle)
unsupported.G10.movement_noise_floor_pp: NOT_COMPUTED_IN_BUILD: VP movement is not noise-gated; tracking error uses G10.nonfollowing_error_pp
unsupported.G11.spike_noise_multiplier: SPIKE_RULE_COMPILED: spikes are counted with the compiled delta-PV criterion
unsupported.G11.late_health_correction_horizon_s: NOT_APPLIED_IN_BUILD: late health corrections revise device intervals (context job) without a horizon bound
unsupported.G12.validation_rmse_max_pv_eu: VALIDATION_RULE_COMPILED: the holdout verdict compares the free-run RMSE with the noise floor and the baseline model (compiled ratios)
unsupported.G12.confidence_level: UNCERTAINTY_METHOD_FIXED: the streaming evaluator reports COVARIANCE standard errors; interval levels / bootstrap are kernel features not wired to the job
unsupported.G12.bootstrap_repetitions: UNCERTAINTY_METHOD_FIXED: block / event bootstrap are kernel features not wired to the streaming job
unsupported.G12.model_max_age_s: API_POLICY: model expiry is a review decision served by the API (as-of reads), not an engine property
unsupported.G14.confirmation_record_max_age_s: API_POLICY: confirmation record age is served by the API
unsupported.G14.require_independent_review: API_POLICY: review independence is enforced by the configuration lifecycle (approve != author), not by the engine
unsupported.G15.hypothesis_score_display_min: DISPLAY_POLICY: the API / UI display floor, not an engine property
unsupported.G15.notification_repeat_s: API_POLICY: notification cadence belongs to the service
unsupported.G0.acquisition_mode: ACQUISITION_FROM_REGISTRY: the acquisition contract rides cplm.loop.model (registry), not the bundle
unsupported.G1.auto_tokens: VENDOR_MODE_MAP_IS_INGESTION_CONFIG: mode tokens are mapped by the data source's mode_map at ingestion (CENTUM enum), not by the engine
unsupported.G3.objective_type: OBJECTIVE_FROM_REGISTRY: the objective type is a registry dimension (cplm.loop.model), mapped to the pack's service objective
unsupported.G5.signal_role: SHAPE_SIGNAL_BY_CLASS: the oscillation signal is OP for self-regulating and PV for integrating loops (dynamic class), not a free property
unsupported.G6.estimator: ESTIMATOR_FIXED_WELCH_PSD: this build computes the Welch PSD only; LEGACY_DFT is not selectable (DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED)
unsupported.G7.shape_method: METHOD_FIXED: CYCLE_SINE_TRIANGLE_V1 is the only installed shape method
unsupported.G8.method: METHOD_FIXED: LAG_ASYMMETRY_V1 (XCORR_ASYMMETRY_V1) is the only installed G8 method; BICOHERENCE_V1 / SURROGATE_NONLINEARITY_V1 are DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED
unsupported.G12.model_families: FAMILY_SELECTION_AUTOMATIC: the estimator tries the installed families for the loop's dynamic class; a per-loop allow-list is not read
unsupported.G12.estimator: ESTIMATOR_BY_PATH: EXOGENOUS_OUTPUT_ERROR for applied-input events, CLOSED_LOOP_PEM for routine data - chosen by the event path, not configurable; VALIDATED_IV not installed
unsupported.G12.uncertainty_method: UNCERTAINTY_METHOD_FIXED: QUALIFIED_COVARIANCE in the streaming job
unsupported.G13.peer_binding_ids: PEERS_FROM_REGISTRY: peers are the registry's loop links broadcast as cplm.loop.evidence, not a bundle property
unsupported.G14.allowed_evidence_types: EVIDENCE_TYPES_FIXED: a positive non-following record or an approved test record; VP presence is never a proof type (compiled)
